ops.title: Locate metadata traversal: predicate ordering and resolver candidate
ops.body: At SDK18 commit3a605abb2b3576ab36520b1e30a0d2dce3341fee, locate_step canonicalizes, checks authority, and stats every entry before filename/ID rejection (snapshot.rs10568-10636). Early filename rejection suppresses existing restricted-root/self-loop errors and is not equivalent. Direct acquisition does not seed locations, but blind seeding changes filename matching and duplicate precedence. Existing ResolvedDirs (snapshot_prepared_service.rs3114-3189) is a conditional page-local realpath-amortization candidate; its hold/error/memory contracts need CI proof. Saved SDK17 locate resource829143d1164e6978 shows40960entries/28620.8ms across10pages; exact caller and repeated/cold attribution remain UNKNOWN.
